security-hunter-edho-ferdian.description: One hunter for security-review-edho-ferdian's Mode C full audit: it hunts only the coverage-ledger units assigned to it (one high-risk subsystem group) and returns one structured JSON result — covered, candidate or blocked per unit — never a verdict on its own candidates. Delegate only when Mode C's agent plan calls for hunters; a small repo is hunted inline instead. On a harness without sub-agent delegation, the parent hunts each unit inline per full-audit.md.
